rules.behavior: BitmapSurfaceLoader uses System.Drawing.Bitmap at native pixel size; upper-left RGB is the source color key. Picture chooses four seasons and day/night. A season day override without night builds its own night; an unspecified season inherits spring day and spring night. getNightOverride checks only the FIRST override child; do not silently reinterpret later night siblings. Automatic night divides RGB components by 4, except (8,0,0)->(255,8,8), (0,8,0)->(252,243,148), (0,0,8)->(255,227,99), also transforming the key. Native RGB555/565 quantization differs from RGB888: retain as fidelity decision, not arbitrary browser recoloring. ExAV replaces the old DirectDraw.AlphaBlend DLL with DirectXWrapper.NightImageBuilder in lib/DirectXWraper/AlphaBlender.cpp; the old native paths are absent. The 32-bit native branch preserves the high byte and quarters masked low RGB bytes. Native 16-bit mode detection compares the red mask three times: do not claim these branches were runtime-validated.

rules.behavior: Source rectangle origin/size and destination anchor offset are distinct. draw places top-left at projected voxel point minus offset; preserve transparent margins. Default loader 0D uses offset=(0,h), origin attribute, size default 32x32. 2D cell x,y: origin=(originX+16*(x+y),originY), offset=(0,h+8*(y-x)), size=(32,min(maxHeight,h+16+8*(y-x))); h is supplied height unless offset overrides, maxHeight is sprite height attribute or Int32.MaxValue. Zero height produces NullSprite. 3D splits roof/front/edge slices, clips negative roof origins, fills invisible cells with NullSprite; use pinned load3D body as the complete algorithm. Invisible sprite does not mean unoccupied voxel. Default loader ID spriteLoader:default.
